title: apps/dashboard/ module responsibility and split from pkg/registry/apis/dashboard/
answers: Where do dashboard API types and migrations live vs. HTTP handlers?
Why can't I find REST handlers under apps/dashboard/?
body:
apps/dashboard is a standalone Go module (apps/dashboard/go.mod, wired into root go.work) built on the Grafana App SDK. It owns the dashboard schema/type/migration layer only: K8s-style API types for Dashboard, LibraryPanel, Snapshot, Variable, Notebook across six coexisting API versions (v0alpha1, v1, v1beta1, v2, v2alpha1, v2beta1 under apps/dashboard/pkg/apis/dashboard/), generated from CUE schemas in apps/dashboard/kinds/*/dashboard_spec.cue. Two migration engines live here too: legacy dashboard-JSON schema-version upgrades (pkg/migration/schemaversion/v2.go..v42.go) and typed cross-version conversions (pkg/migration/conversion/).
The actual REST handlers, storage wiring, and admission/validation logic are NOT in apps/dashboard/ — they live in the root-level package pkg/registry/apis/dashboard/ (register.go, dashboard_storage.go, sub_dto.go). Grep both locations when a task mentions "dashboard API".
